mainEntity.name: How much does a Land Rover Discovery TD6 engine replacement cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: A fully rebuilt Land Rover Discovery TD6 engine typically costs between £7,500 and £11,000 for supply only, with supply and fit packages ranging higher depending on the specialist. - Supply-only rebuilt (306DT): £7,500-£11,000 [EM-QUOTE] - Supply & fit: £9,500-£13,000 [ESTIMATED] - Always ensure the quote includes a minimum 12-month warranty.

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of crankshaft bearing failure in a Land Rover Discovery TD6 (306DT)?

acceptedAnswer.text: The 306DT V6 is prone to bearing fatigue. Early warning signs include a distinct rhythmic knocking noise from the bottom end on cold startup, low oil pressure warnings, or sudden loss of power. - Listen for a deep knocking sound during the first few seconds of engine startup. - Monitor the dashboard for low oil pressure warnings. - Address any unusual engine noises immediately to prevent catastrophic seizure.

mainEntity.name: Is the newer AJ30D6 inline-six engine more reliable than the older 306DT V6?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, the AJ30D6 inline-six architecture resolved the catastrophic bottom-end bearing issues inherent to the 306DT V6 design. However, as a newer, more complex mild-hybrid system, it requires strict adherence to service intervals to prevent EGR and electrical faults. - The inline-six design eliminates the V6 oiling and packaging flaws. - Mild-hybrid components require specialist diagnostic equipment. - Rebuilt AJ30D6 units include updated EGR and electrical components.

mainEntity.name: Is it worth replacing the engine in a Land Rover Discovery TD6?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, investing in a rebuilt engine is financially sound. With Land Rover Discovery TD6 values currently ranging from £25,000 to over £60,000 depending on year and specification, a £7,500-£11,000 replacement is a small fraction of the vehicle's worth and preserves this premium asset. - Premium Discovery values easily absorb rebuild costs. - A rebuilt engine resets the mechanical lifespan with upgraded components. - Upgraded parts prevent repeat failures.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Land Rover Discovery TD6 engine replacement take?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard supply and fit service for a Land Rover Discovery TD6 typically takes 3 to 5 days at a specialist workshop. The complex 48V mild-hybrid system (on newer models) and tight engine bay require meticulous removal and calibration. - Removal and installation: 2-3 days. - Fluid top-up, system bleeding, and ECU calibration: 1-2 days. - Always confirm turnaround times with your chosen specialist.

historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery TD6 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the Discovery 5 (L462) launched with the TD6 badge, it offered a potent 3.0L V6 diesel, later transitioning to the newer, more efficient Ingenium inline-six diesel architecture to meet stricter emissions and refinement standards while maintaining exceptional towing capability.

milestones.description: 306DT (3.0L V6 Diesel), 258PS (Initial Discovery 5 launch, carrying over the established V6 architecture).
AJ30D6 (3.0L Inline-6 Ingenium Diesel), 258PS-300PS (Major architecture shift to an inline-six with 48V mild-hybrid technology, resolving many V6 packaging and oiling issues).

commonProblems.h2: Land Rover Discovery TD6 Engine Problems - Repair Cost vs Replacement
commonProblems.h3: The Land Rover Discovery TD6 is a powerful and capable engine, but the earlier 306DT V6 is notorious for catastrophic bottom-end failures. The newer AJ30D6 inline-six resolved many of these issues but introduced complex mild-hybrid components. Rebuilt engines through EnginesMarket include upgraded components addressing these original failure points, plus a minimum 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty.

problems.h4: Crankshaft Bearing & Oil Pump Failure - Why the Land Rover Discovery TD6 (306DT) Seizes Prematurely
problems.rootCause: Tin-aluminium coating fatigue on the crankshaft bearings, exacerbated by oil pump starvation, leading to sudden and catastrophic engine seizure.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace oil pump and inspect bearings via sump removal.
repairOptions.longevity: Only viable if caught *before* any knocking or performance loss occurs.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a fully rebuilt 306DT or upgraded AJ30D6, plus 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The only reliable solution once bearing wear or knocking is detected.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Discovery TD6 (2017-2020) currently holds a value of £25,000-£45,000 in the UK [THIRD-PARTY]. A £7,500-£11,000 rebuilt engine replacement is well within the vehicle's value band. Flag: Safe.
problems.recommendation: If cold-start knocking is present, do not attempt a minor repair. A full rebuild or replacement with a revised block is the only safe path to prevent imminent catastrophic failure.

problems.group: EGR Cooler Leaks & Mild-Hybrid Electrical Faults
problems.h4: EGR Cooler Leaks & Mild-Hybrid Electrical Faults - Why the Land Rover Discovery TD6 (AJ30D6) Loses Performance
problems.rootCause: EGR cooler internal leaks contaminating the intake, alongside complex 48V mild-hybrid system component failures triggering limp mode.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Replace faulty EGR cooler, clean intake, and update ECU software.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable for isolated EGR issues without internal engine damage.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit of a fully rebuilt AJ30D6 with updated components, plus 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if EGR coolant ingress has caused hydrolock or severe internal corrosion.

problems.vehicleValueCheck: A typical Land Rover Discovery TD6 (2020-present) currently holds a value of £35,000-£60,000+ in the UK [THIRD-PARTY]. Replacement cost is a small fraction of the vehicle's worth. Flag: Safe.
problems.recommendation: For isolated EGR or electrical faults, specialist repair is cost-effective. For extensive internal damage, a rebuilt unit provides a comprehensive, warrantied reset.
